label: Sana'a — Houthi-Held Capital
sub: Seized by Houthi forces Sep 2014. Seat of the Houthi-run Sana'a government (Supreme Political Council) and Ansar Allah leadership. Sana'a International Airport's runway was struck by Yemeni government forces on Jul 13, 2026, the trigger for the Abha Airport retaliation.

label: Marib — Government-Held Oil City
sub: Yemen's last major government-held city near the Houthi front line and home to over 2 million displaced people. Repeatedly struck by Houthi ballistic missiles and drones in August 2026 (Aug 6 offensive, Aug 15 residential strikes, Aug 16 camp strikes); site of a government counter-offensive claimed successful on Aug 18.

label: Hadramout — Government Military Camps
sub: Camps of Yemen's First Military Region struck alongside Marib on Aug 6, 2026 by Houthi ballistic missiles and drones launched from Al-Jawf, contributing to the 30-58 troops killed in the deadliest single episode of the conflict in years.

label: Al-Jawf — Houthi Missile Launch Site
sub: Houthi-controlled governorate used to launch the Aug 6, 2026 ballistic missile and drone barrage against government camps in Marib and Hadramout.

label: Hodeidah — Houthi-Held Port, Aid Lifeline
sub: Yemen's main humanitarian aid corridor, protected from a full coalition assault by the 2018 Stockholm Agreement. Struck by Saudi-led coalition aircraft on Jul 24-25 and again Aug 13, 2026, targeting military capability while the coalition says the port itself was not hit.

label: Al-Makha (Mokha) — Port Closed After Repeated Strikes
sub: Red Sea port struck by Houthi missiles and drones at least three times in August 2026 (Aug 10, 7 killed; Aug 14, 4-8 killed; Aug 16 renewed attacks), targeting Saudi-backed forces and 'mercenary' buildups. Operations suspended around Aug 18; port director says the cumulative toll reached 16 killed, 22 injured and 1,500+ port workers jobless, with 30 shipping/customs agencies idled and traders rerouting via Aden.

label: Bab al-Mandeb Strait — Tihamah Double-Tap Strike Site
sub: Site of the Aug 11, 2026 Houthi 'double-tap' ballistic missile strike on the cargo ship Tihamah, killing 4 crew and 2 rescuers — the first fatal Houthi attack on shipping since the Iran war began.

label: Taiz — Besieged Government-Held City
sub: Yemen's third-largest city, under Houthi siege since 2015 despite the 2018 Stockholm understanding. Remains a flashpoint front line as fighting resumed elsewhere in August 2026.

label: Aden — Yemen's Interim Government Capital
sub: Seat of the Presidential Leadership Council (PLC) since President Hadi relocated in 2015. PLC Chairman Rashad al-Alimi has directed the government's military and diplomatic response to the August 2026 escalation from here.

label: Saada — Houthi Movement Heartland
sub: Ansar Allah's founding stronghold in far-northern Yemen. Houthis alleged Saudi drone incursions into Saada and Hajjah governorates as justification for the Aug 9, 2026 second Jazan refinery strike.

label: Abha International Airport — Truce-Ending Strike
sub: Struck by Houthi ballistic missiles and drones on Jul 13, 2026 — the group's first claimed attack on Saudi soil since the informal 2022 truce, ending four years of relative calm. Intercepted with no casualties.

label: Jazan Refinery — Twice-Struck Aramco Facility
sub: Aramco's 400,000 bpd refinery, struck by Houthi drones/missiles on Jul 27, 2026 (gasification unit, tank farm) and again Aug 9, 2026 (fire, extinguished by dawn, no injuries). A third strike was claimed by the Houthis on Aug 13 but not independently confirmed.

label: Najran — Repeatedly Targeted Border City
sub: Saudi border city struck by Houthi projectiles Aug 7, 2026, wounding 11 civilians including a 4-year-old — the Kingdom's highest civilian toll in over four years. On Aug 20, 2026 the Houthis claimed drone strikes on Najran Airport and an Aramco facility, unconfirmed by Saudi authorities. Historically a recurring Houthi cross-border target since 2015; home to a significant Ismaili Shia minority.

label: Yanbu — Red Sea Export Terminal, Blockade Target
sub: Saudi Arabia's key Red Sea crude export route, explicitly threatened by the Houthis' Jul 20, 2026 blockade declaration. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said Aramco facilities at Yanbu were also targeted in the last week of July.

label: Riyadh — Saudi Political & Military Command
sub: Seat of MBS and the Saudi-led coalition command. Hosted the Aug 7, 2026 briefing where PLC Chairman al-Alimi told ambassadors the international community must address the 'sources and instruments' of the Houthi threat.

label: Mecca — Joint Defence Agreement Signing
sub: Site of the Aug 7, 2026 signing of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement between MBS, Erdoğan and Shehbaz Sharif, declaring an attack on any signatory an attack on all three — signed the same day as the Najran attack.

label: Dhahran — Aramco HQ, Eastern Province
sub: Headquarters of Saudi Aramco. Placed on high alert as Houthi strikes on Jazan and Yanbu raised fears of a wider campaign against Saudi oil infrastructure reminiscent of the 2019 Abqaiq-Khurais attack.

label: Jeddah/Riyadh Corridor — Red Sea Coalition Summit
sub: Diplomatic hub for the Jul 30, 2026 Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition summit, where 43 of 51 invited states plus the EU convened; 14 signed the founding statement to protect Bab el-Mandeb, the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden.

label: Tanker Seamull — Hijacked Off Yemen (Aug 20)
sub: Approximate location, ~136nm east of al-Mukalla, where six armed men boarded the tanker Seamull (SIBU 1) on Aug 20, 2026 and diverted it toward Somalia, per UKMTO. Part of a resurgence of Somali piracy compounding the security vacuum from the Houthi-Saudi war and naval blockade.

label: Gulf of Aden — Coalition Patrol Zone
sub: Maritime approach to Bab al-Mandeb patrolled under the Red Sea Maritime Defence Coalition framework following the Jul 20 Houthi blockade declaration and the fatal Aug 11 Tihamah attack.

label: Khamis Mushait — Air Base Near Abha
sub: Major Saudi air base adjoining Abha, on heightened alert since the Jul 13, 2026 Houthi missile and drone attack on Abha International Airport.

label: Hajjah — Alleged Saudi Drone Incursion Zone
sub: Houthi-controlled governorate where the group alleged Saudi drone incursions in early August 2026, cited as justification for the Aug 9 second Jazan refinery strike.

label: VLCC Amzan — Struck Off Yanbu (Aug 24)
sub: Approximate location, ~63nm west of Yanbu, where a Houthi anti-ship ballistic missile hit the Saudi-flagged VLCC Amzan (Bahri) on Aug 24, 2026, sparking a fire on the main deck. All crew safe, no environmental damage reported. Part of the Houthis' 'siege-for-siege' maritime ban on Saudi-linked shipping.

label: Marib Displacement Camps
sub: Camps sheltering part of Marib's 2 million+ displaced population, struck by six Houthi ballistic missiles and four drones on Aug 16, 2026, wounding at least four and damaging shelters.
